description:
Delete a coupon.  Cascades to all patron redemptions.

Any chain step referencing the deleted coupon_id becomes a
no-op (the constraint returns neutral on unknown ids) — the
Studio surfaces orphan references as warnings.

RESTRICTED to operator — requires proof.

coupon_id.description: The id of the coupon to delete (from list_coupons).

dpop_token.description:
Proof that the caller holds the operator's npub: the grant
envelope from receive_npub_proof, or the raw JSON of a kind-27235
Nostr event signed by the operator whose `u` tag is this tool's name.

name: brain_delete_coupon
title: Delete coupon
